titlebar.surface: continuous with rail and sidebar; no dividing stripe
titlebar.actions: contextual navigation and panels only; theme and language live in settings
titlebar.composition: shell-owned defaults; explicit custom mode for documented exception

corners.controls: existing radius tokens; superellipse when supported

activityRail.requiredWhen: the application has multiple major workspaces
activityRail.role: select major workspaces in multi-workspace apps

sidebar.requiredWhen: the selected workspace has multiple destinations
sidebar.role: contextual destinations within the selected workspace

rightPanel.visibility: controlled optional region with labeled close action

workspace.surface: single rounded canvas inset on continuous chrome
workspace.scrolling: main and supporting regions own scrolling

settingsWindow.layout: section navigation left, selected form right
settingsWindow.paddingOwnership: settings owns gutters; shell contentPadding none
settingsWindow.responsive: container-based row stacking and section navigation

commandPalette.entry: field-like button at titlebar upper right

feedback.toast: reversible changes; offer undo when meaningful
feedback.banner: one persistent warning or status slot above the composer
feedback.inlineError: one failed section; keep retry in that section
feedback.overlay: blocking decision or short task; focus must return to trigger

pageHeader.description: operational constraints only; no filler or conversational subtitle
